fields.description: Byte-sum checksum of save block (sum of bytes at save offsets 4..2619 mod 65536, stored little-endian). Written by FUN_0800ae14 and verified by FUN_0800ae94 via FUN_0800af20.
fields.evidence: FUN_0800af20 sums bytes [param_1, param_1+param_2); FUN_0800ae14 stores it at heap-buffer offset 0 before SRAM write; FUN_0800ae94 recomputes over SRAM bytes [4, block_end) and compares with stored u16 at offset 0.
fields.name: slot_checksum

fields.description: Slot validity marker: 1 means the slot holds initialized save data, 0 means empty. Copied between the per-slot RAM staging struct (+2) and save offset 2; the checksum-failure path in FUN_0800ae94 forces marker to 1 with checksum 0 (as seen in baseline).
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ae14 copies staging u16 at (DAT_0800ae7c + slot*0x20 + 2) to save offset 2; FUN_0800ae94 failure path writes marker 1 to both the SRAM buffer and staging (DAT_0800af1c / DAT_0800aef4 + slot*0x20).
fields.name: slot_status

fields.description: Event/state flag byte serialized from game-state offset 0x31C; cleared to 0 by event dispatch in FUN_08034ca8 (event cases 0x04/0x06).
fields.evidence: FUN_08005048 writes game-state byte at +0x31C to save offset 4; FUN_080052a0 restores it on load; FUN_08034ca8 writes 0 to game-state +0x31C on handled events.
fields.name: event_flag

fields.description: Total score counter (game-state +0x32C, initialized to 1000). Rendered as decimal digits and compared against thresholds in FUN_08015528; decremented/redistributed by round results in FUN_08015b98.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000838 initializes game-state u32 at +0x32C to 1000; FUN_08015528 renders it digit-by-digit (div/mod by 1000/100/10); FUN_08015b98 subtracts round deltas from it; FUN_08005048 serializes it to save offset 0x0C and FUN_080052a0 restores it.
